name: print-social-lime-black-brand-struggle-post-with-tilted-chat-cards
title: Struggling to Build Your Brand Post
whatItIs: A dark square post covered in giant outlined ghost letters of a brand name, with a logo row, a lime headline 'STRUGGLING TO BUILD YOUR BRAND?' and a white line 'WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED!', two tilted olive-green chat cards (a client question and the agency reply) with lime icon tiles, and a CONTACT US label with an outlined URL pill.
whatItMeans: A two-message dialogue shows a problem and answer in seconds, and tilting the cards makes it feel like a live chat.
techniques: Problem line then payoff line in two colours
Two tilted chat cards as a dialogue
Lime icon tiles for client and agency
Outline ghost lettering across the background
Gradient of olive green at the corners

vocabulary.definition: A card representing one side of a conversation.
A question followed by a reassuring answer.
Large faint letters used as a background.
